async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Click the Settings link to go to the project edit page
    # The Settings link is under the complementary role 'Project navigation'
    settings_link = page.get_by_role('complementary', name='Project navigation').get_by_role('link', name='Settings')
    await settings_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Wait a bit for elements to render
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Find the title field. In GitLab settings, it's typically a textbox with label 'Project name'.
    # Use get_by_label if available, else get_by_role with name.
    title_field = page.get_by_label('Project name')
    if not await title_field.count():
        # Fallback: try get_by_role with name
        title_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name')
    # Clear the existing value and set to 'GIVE ME SPACE'
    await title_field.fill('')
    await title_field.fill('GIVE ME SPACE')
    # Find and click the save button
    save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save changes')
    if not await save_button.count():
        save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save')
    await save_button.click()
    # Wait for save to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # After saving, we might be redirected back to the project page. No further action needed.
